additional_info.subject: RE: ID0393020-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312555359052] Charger are out of order. CRM:00641000810
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding this case, the charger is currently not online on SCB, which prevents us from taking any remote actions.
We kindly request that you schedule a site intervention and inform us at least one day in advance so that a team member can be available to assist you.
In the meantime, please address the following queries to help us diagnose the issue more effectively:
Is this the only charger where this issue occurs?
If yes:
It could be an issue with either the router or the SIM card.
I recommend swapping the SIM card with another charger that is not experiencing the OCPP offline issue.
If the error appears in the other charger, it will indicate the SIM card is the problem.
However, if swapping the SIM cards results in connectivity drops in the original charger, it would point to the router being faulty.
If no:
We need to determine whether there are communication drops from the network provider.
Additionally, please check what differs between a working charger and a non-working one (e.g., signal strength).
Please confirm if WAN Failover is enabled?
If WAN Failover is ON, it could explain the need for a reboot. When the mobile connection fails, the system might switch to Wired/Wi-Fi and not revert to mobile without on-site intervention
.
Also,
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
